name: commit to both a corrected bill and the exact refund
text: 我会重开发票，给您原路退二百元。

name: Arabic numeral and CNY decimal
text: 账单我会改正，多收的人民币200.00元退到原来的账户。

name: no punctuation between invoice total and refund
text: 我把账单改成1000元给您退200块

name: Han currency and full correction
text: 发票上金额填错了，我给您换一张正确的，多扣两百块原路退。

name: explicit full overcharge resolves the known difference
text: 新账单我会重新开，超收的部分全额返还。

name: bare full refund has a different scope
text: 我们全额退款。

name: courtesy doesn't touch either obligation
text: 给您添麻烦了，实在对不住。

name: discount isn't a return of overcharged funds
text: 这次给您打九折，新的发票我会重开。

name: loss compensation isn't a refund
text: 我赔您二百元当违约金，账单还是那张。

name: voucher value doesn't count as actual refund
text: 二百元的代金券我发过来了，账单会给您改正。

name: a lower amount is recognized but insufficient
text: 我会修正账单，原账户只能退一百元。

name: an excessive amount needs correction
text: 我给您重开一份账单，再退三百元。

name: different currency doesn't transfer just because the number matches
text: 我给您重开账单，退您二百美元。

name: cents aren't rounded into a correct refund
text: 新的发票会重开，给您退200.05元。

name: relative amount is available when asked
text: 请问你们多付了多少？

name: invoice number is available
text: 方便告诉我发票号码吗？

name: short amount after direct client prompt
text: 两百块。

name: standalone amount without prompt isn't a refund
text: 是两百。

name: pending approval so far
text: 退两百块还得等财务批准，我先重开发票。

name: customer reports finance's proposal
text: 财务同事说可以退二百元，我还没确定。

name: conditional amounts do not commit now
text: 如果主管同意就退二百元，到时候再说。

name: polite option needs an actual decision
text: 给你退二百块钱行不行？

name: amount correction within one turn
text: 我会更正发票，先前说退一百不对，实际给您退两百。

name: unqualified correction cannot leave the old promise active
text: 刚才那个退款不算，得重新核对。

name: a clarification doesn't withdraw a promise
text: 您同事也提到过退款吗？我会把发票改好。

name: unrelated amount close to a refund statement stays unassigned
text: 这期会费200元，今天给客户退款。

name: a shipping promise cannot resolve a billing issue
text: 我们保证周四把货送到。

name: one component is still being requested
text: 我们现在给您退两百块。

name: invoice verification isn't correction
text: 我先去确认发票和金额，然后给您退二百元。

name: a promise to cancel the wrong invoice isn't a corrected invoice
text: 我会把错的发票作废，多扣的两百原路退。

name: split same-channel repayments add up only when both are explicit
text: 发票重开，今天先退100元，明天再退100元。

name: count only the promised part of a split repayment
text: 今天先退一百块，另外一百还要申请。

name: a corrected invoice with an incorrect amount remains open
text: 账单给您改成一千一百元，把超收的二百元退给您。

name: spoken fen and jiao carry the amount
text: 重开发票，给您退二百元三毛五分。

name: a rejected invoice action does not negate a distinct refund
text: 发票我们不会重开给您退200元。

name: new question about the amount cannot overwrite the confirmed answer
before: 我们把超收的二百块退给您。
text: 退款那边还要确认多少吗？

name: an approval clause limits an otherwise complete refund offer
text: 给您退回200元，但是要先得到主管批准。

name: a separate explicit balance builds on the previous offer
before: 我给您退90元，账单重新开。
text: 剩下的一百一十元也退回您卡上。

name: an amount after an explicit correction replaces an old amount
before: 我给您退90元，账单重新开。
text: 我说错了，一共给您退200元。

name: a comma can group thousands in the invoice amount
text: 账单改成1,100元，另给您退200元。

name: ordinary spoken shorthand is a whole yuan amount
text: 账单重新开一下，原路给您退两百五。
